goal: Lock the renderer-only mobile product contract and independent profile isolation boundary.
description: Scope: docs/plan/layout-management/mobile/Requirements.md only; define users, workflows, REQ-001 through REQ-010, scope, non-goals, and final acceptance. Context: the prior child plan mixed profile rendering with parent-owned registration, Settings, cutover, migration, and native verification. Target: one delivery contract for two isolated mobile LayoutSurfaceBundle exports and a renderer receipt. Design Considerations: retain shared semantic identity and parent state authority while making isolation a first-class local requirement. Design Value: a narrow contract lets workbench and studio develop independently and prevents duplicated integration ownership. Constraints & Risks: do not weaken whole-product behavior; route central composition, fixed-shell deletion, app cutover, build, and launch to the parent integration join.

acceptance_criteria.text: Requirements.md defines the mobile renderer problem, users, workflows, scope, non-goals, and final acceptance target.
REQ-001 through REQ-010 define two complete bundles, exact destination adapters, state/environment behavior, renderer-only ownership, evidence, and independent profile isolation.
The contract explicitly assigns registry, app, ClientShell, Settings, old-shell removal, integration, Android/iOS build, device, and launch work to the parent join.

goal: Implement workbench mobile shell, component recipes, tokens, and preview within its exclusive source files.
description: Scope: exclusively workbench_mobile_shell.dart, workbench_mobile_components.dart, workbench_mobile_tokens.dart, and workbench_mobile_preview.dart under apps/desktop/lib/src/frontend/layout/profiles/workbench/mobile; consume completed parent layout contracts and narrow ports. Target: compact/medium card-and-stack composition, contextual navigation, composer clearance, profile tokens, accessible component recipes, public-metadata preview, and a workbench-only restoration prefix. Design Considerations: render immutable supplied state; use constraints/insets/input facts locally; keep styled recipes private; build no registry or domain authority. Constraints & Risks: do not edit destinations, bundle entry, tests, goldens, assets outside an approved namespace, sibling profile, central integration, ClientController, shell, Settings, or platform code.
